title: Queue delivery
description: Hub to connector: place one hub-queued message in a chat's daemon queue (C-07.26). The connector sends it as a relayed POST /api/queue/message (05 C-05.45), never a host request, with hub_msg_id as client_msg_id and the actor header (03) when it holds one. The message fields are those POST /api/queue/message takes (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/composer.js badField and validateMessage); the limits are composer.js's MESSAGE_MAX 3000, SKILL_ARGS_MAX 300, FILES_MAX 5, PATH_MAX 240.

hub_msg_id.description: The hub's message id: hm_ and a ULID, minted once when the hub accepts the message (C-07.25). Also sent to the daemon as client_msg_id.

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its `cht_` prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat on the link. The hub maps it to the chat id it records.

attempt.description: 1 on first send, plus 1 on each redelivery (C-07.28).

enqueued_at.description: Hub clock when the hub accepted the message. For display only on the connector (C-07.31).

deliver_within_ms.description: Remaining life at send time, measured by the connector from receipt on a monotonic clock; past it the connector answers expired without posting (C-07.27, C-07.31). Absent: no expiry.

from.description: Who sent it, as contract 03's principal, for Activity. Not sent to the daemon in the body. The X-WC-Actor the connector stamps on the delivery comes from 05's frame field `actor`, never from this field (C-05.44).

message.description: The body the connector POSTs, with hub_msg_id added as client_msg_id.

text.description: The message text. The daemon normalises it and refuses over MESSAGE_MAX (too_large).

skill.description: A skill to run, or null.

oneOf.description: A path as an object, as the composer sends it.

conversation_id.description: The conversation to target (composer.js CONVERSATION_ID_RE), or null.

device.description: The sender's device, which pushProvenance records with origin remote (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/queue.js:28-32; lib/server/domain/queue.js DEVICES). Absent: the daemon falls back to the User-Agent (C-07.26).
